name: NFFT Development Container
postCreateCommand: mkdir -p ~/.claude && sh -c 'echo "n" | rtk init -g --auto-patch' && sh -c 'touch ~/.gitignore_global && grep -qxF .DS_Store ~/.gitignore_global || printf "%s\n" .DS_Store >> ~/.gitignore_global'

rtk init -g --auto-patch && git config --global --add safe.directory ${containerWorkspaceFolder} && sh -c 'touch ~/.gitignore_global && grep -qxF .DS_Store ~/.gitignore_global || printf "%s\n" .DS_Store >> ~/.gitignore_global' && git config --global core.excludesfile ~/.gitignore_global
